newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 79 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 79 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon said on Thursday it issued certificates of deposit dated August 1 to commercial banks worth 79 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 74 billion pounds at 12.25 percent annual interest. It sold 45-day CDs worth 5 billion pounds at the same interest rate.
Last week, the bank sold 60-day certificates worth 17 billion pounds at 12.25 percent annual interest. It said there was no demand for 45-day CDs.
